market_summary: London session displays clear strength in USD with EURUSD and GBPUSD breaking below Value Area Low and key support levels with expanding ATR and bearish CVD alignment. XAUUSD and BTCUSD remain bound within fair value ranges near VWAP/POC, while US100 consolidates near session highs inside value area.

signals.rationale: Price is above VAH (4056.29) and above POC (4044.58). CVD is NEUTRAL (-0.16) with a slightly negative slope (-0.19). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price remains above VWAP (4048.34) and EMA50 (4051.21), holding near EMA20 baseline (4055.37). Position is mid-channel within ATR bands (4043.98 - 4066.77). RVOL is low (0.731) with no active volume spikes. With price hovering right at VAH without strong momentum or volume expansion, setup lacks decisive breakout confirmation.

Price is below VAL (1.11534) and below POC (1.11654). CVD is BEARISH (-5254) with accelerating negative slope (-938.0), confirming aggressive selling. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is trading below VWAP (1.11582) and below EMA50 (1.11623), pressing down against the lower ATR band (1.11449). RVOL shows elevated volume (1.314) following recent yellow spikes. Price has broken below Prev Low (1.11456) and is pushing toward Session Low (1.11393) under clear structural breakdown conditions.

Price is trading below VAL (1.33311) and below POC (1.33470). CVD is BEARISH (-1470) with a strong negative slope (-1358.54). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is well below VWAP (1.33385) and EMA50 (1.33443), riding the lower ATR band (1.33225). RVOL is elevated at 1.421 with volume expanding on down-bars. Price is sweeping near Session Low (1.33149) and Prev Low (1.33119) with strong downside momentum across all timeframe baselines.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 28001.73 .. VAH 28230.85) and above POC (28111.52). CVD is BULLISH (+7.12) with positive slope (+1.13). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is solidly above VWAP (28051.41) and EMA50 (28012.82), holding above EMA20 (28125.07). ATR bands are high but price is consolidating near Session High / VAH (28230.85). Note Dukascopy US100 tick volume rarely prints >2.0 RVOL. However, price is currently testing the session extreme inside VA upper boundary after an extended run, favoring consolidation over chasing high entries.
signals.level_event: rejection of upper ATR band / near Session High

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 73472.70 .. VAH 73788.83) and trading around POC (73699.92). CVD is slightly BEARISH (-0.04) with flat slope (-0.01). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is hovering around VWAP (73622.13), EMA20 (73697.67), and EMA50 (73672.93) in a tight mean-reverting cluster. Mid-channel within ATR limits (73260.28 - 74135.07) with low RVOL (0.894) and zero volume spikes. Market lacks directional catalyst and is bound within session value area.
